core_obligations: (3) => (1): J regular by the join lemmas; the Koszul complex is a finite free resolution of S/J over S/IS, so finite projective dimension, transferred to finite tor dimension over R/I by flatness.

(2) => (3): the perfect-over-regular lemma gives finite tor dimension over S/IS; the regular-sequence lemma splits IS and J/IS into regular sequences; minimality transfers f_1, ..., f_r back to a regular sequence in R via flatness and flat-increases-depth.
proof_roadmap: Prove the three implications with the Koszul-resolution step and the splitting argument.
difficulty_reason: The workhorse equivalence of the chapter's CI-maps section; the (2) => (3) chain strings five inputs in the right order.
